about: Offline trophy guide and tracker for all 55 PS5 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned; no online trophies. Official names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, cross-checked between Exophase and PSNProfiles as carried in the make.fun kit starter. Every guide below is written for this entry in its own words and names its sources beside it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task. Plan around the long tail instead. A Long Road (100% completion) and the collectible grinds set the pace at roughly 200 hours, so chip away at stunts, WAiNK scans and meditation spots from Chapter 1 instead of leaving them all for the end.
trophies.when: Pops last, once everything else is done.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it pops as the mission ends. Like every story trophy it is hidden on PlayStation until earned. Right after it, head into Jason's house: the Chapter 1 meditation interaction tied to Positive Mental Attitude becomes available in this stretch of the game.
trophies.when: Opening mission of Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1; chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the final cutscene. Before you close the chapter, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house and park a manual save in its own slot, because the game has no mission replay and that meditation does not come back.
trophies.when: End of Chapter 1. Do the balcony meditation first.

trophies.guide: Finish the main missions of Chapter 2. This is the chapter that opens the game up: character switching and calling in your partner arrive after Breakfast Run, and the garage, Scooter Bros and Kingpin Bowling systems unlock along the way, so start the partner and property trophies here rather than later.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish the main missions of Chapter 3. Two time-sensitive habits matter in this chapter: take the Snap Gun jewelry job as soon as Yasmani offers it, and run the Race Against Yago strand the moment it appears, because that race is marked with an hourglass and can expire as the chapter advances.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: One of only two gold trophies: finish the final story mission. Before you start it, save in a fresh manual slot and never overwrite that slot afterwards. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus at launch, so that untouched save is your only way back if a late interaction was missed.
trophies.when: Final mission. Keep an untouched save from just before it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold and the real platinum gate: fill the in-game 100% checklist, which appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story, although everything you do earlier already counts. Reported checklist landmarks include 300 stunts (the trophy only asks 250), 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles discovered, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations. Nothing on the checklist is missable, so treat it as a marathon, not a trap.
trophies.when: Post-story cleanup; the checklist itself appears after the credits.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts across Leonida: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and there are 397 stunts in the game, so you need a little over half of them. Do not stop at 250 if you want the platinum: the 100% checklist asks for 300. Work stunt clusters region by region whenever you pass through, instead of saving one giant stunt tour for the end.
trophies.when: Any time in free roam; 100% completion needs 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every one of the game's 9 activity types at least once: races, drone races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, meditation, hunting, stunts and challenges are the families the list draws from. You only need a single attempt at each, not a win, so clear this early as a tour of Leonida and let it teach you where everything lives for the grind trophies.
trophies.when: Any time; easiest as a deliberate tour once free roam opens up.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (make.fun kit starter data)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the game's two ranges. Learn each challenge's target order on a practice run, then chase gold with a full magazine and a steady sensitivity; medals are kept per challenge, so you can grind the stubborn ones individually. These 42 golds also sit inside the 100% checklist, so nothing here is wasted effort.
trophies.when: Any time the ranges are open; also part of the 100% checklist.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (make.fun kit starter data)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; you do not need every race variant, just a win per location. Learn each course's line on a first attempt, then rerun it immediately while the route is fresh. Tick locations off region by region so the last few are easy to find on the map.
trophies.when: Any time; one win at each of 14 locations.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (make.fun kit starter data)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeat wins on the same race do not add to the count. Bring a car that suits the class, learn the first three corners of each new course, and treat the Race Against Yago strand in Chapter 3 as one of your twenty, because that one is time-sensitive while the rest wait for you.
trophies.when: Any time; one of them (Race Against Yago, Chapter 3) is time-sensitive.

Fishing challenges are available early, and guides suggest clearing this in Chapter 1 while you are still near the starting area: learn the bite timing on a cheap first attempt, then play the challenge properly once the rhythm clicks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. Not every optional questline counts: the named strands that carry their own trophies (Andy, Billy, Tyrone, and the other finales) do not add to this counter, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One strand needs care: the Race Against Yago race in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive with an hourglass icon, so run it the moment it appears instead of banking it for later.
trophies.when: Watch: one strand (Race Against Yago, Chapter 3) can expire. The rest wait.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable trophy of the list. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida; spots show as purple icons when you are close, and outdoor spots should count for both characters if you meditate there with your partner along. The trap is the first one: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1 (a morning after the mission Down to Earth, she steps out from the kitchen) disappears when Chapter 1 ends, and with no mission replay there is no way back. It is not yet confirmed that the trophy strictly needs that spot, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, which is why this trophy, not the checklist, is the risk.
trophies.when: MISSABLE: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is gone after Chapter 1.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (make.fun kit starter data)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is played as Jason, until he sends you after a unique animal, and bring that animal down. Bret's hunts run through target decks, and a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what his grading cares about. The strand stays available after the story.
trophies.when: Side-story (Bret, Jason only); stays open after the story ends.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are a collectible family of their own (separate from Bret's hunting target decks), so sweep them area by area as you explore for The Goodtime State and scan as you go; finishing whole sets, not raw card count, is what the counter tracks. Prioritise the three shortest sets if you only want the trophy, but the rest still feed exploration progress.
trophies.when: Any time in free roam; 3 complete sets.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (make.fun kit starter data)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations. WAiNK is also your discovery tool: scanning a vehicle with it counts toward Whip It Good, so make scanning a habit every time you park somewhere new and the two counters climb together. Locations are spread across the whole state, so this pairs naturally with the 52-area exploration sweep.
trophies.when: Any time; builds fastest while exploring all 52 areas.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (make.fun kit starter data)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, listed in the game under Progress, then Challenges, split into eight categories of 10 (Combat and Vehicle among them) and available from the start. Many complete on their own while you play the rest of the list. The trophy asks 50, but the 100% checklist asks 70 of 80, so keep going after this pops if the platinum is the goal.
trophies.when: Any time; 100% completion needs 70 of 80.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner called in (possible after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2), earn a 4-star wanted level together and then lose it completely. The efficient route is a bank vault job from Chapter 4: vaults hand you 4 stars immediately and your partner is already with you to carry the bags, so escaping that one job can earn this trophy on the way out. The trophy pops only once you have fully left the red heat zone, not merely the flashing search area.
trophies.when: Needs partner play (after Chapter 2); easiest during a Chapter 4 vault job.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner in, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still actively chasing you: the chain breaks if your stars fade and you drop into the red heat zone, so keep moving and keep the wanted level alive between shops. Pick three shops close together on the same street run. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before robbing a fourth.
trophies.when: Needs partner play (after Chapter 2).

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive and sweep parking lots and rich neighbourhoods for models you have not seen. The trophy asks 100, but 100% completion asks for 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this pops.
trophies.when: Any time; 100% completion needs 200 of 277.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside one activation of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim triggered by pressing L3 and R3 while aiming. Set it up deliberately: pick a packed group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, carry an assault rifle, and remember that adrenaline extends Focus, so chain kills quickly before it drains.
trophies.when: Any time you can find five grouped enemies; gang operations are ideal.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger jet that is docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport and take off in it; the jets at gates E3 and E4 are the ones that work, while planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The trophy is delayed: fly roughly 1 km away from the airport before it pops. Save first, because the police response is fast.
trophies.when: Free roam at VCIA; use a jet at a boarding bridge (gates E3/E4).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get out unseen. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies: use the Snap Gun on the locked back door, because kicking the door in sets off the alarm and ruins the attempt. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if anyone spots you, reload and retry rather than pushing on.
trophies.when: Unlocks in Chapter 3 (Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Snap Gun).

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Every vault job starts at a 4-star wanted level, which makes these runs double as Hot Together attempts. The trophy asks 5; the 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults.
trophies.when: Unlocks late Chapter 4; 100% completion needs all 8 vaults.

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida so the whole map is explored. Work it as a deliberate sweep once the story opens the full state: drive each region's roads, and pair the trip with WAiNK scans (100 locations) and vehicle discoveries so three counters finish on the same tour.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation owned by each of the 9 gangs. Variety is the whole task: a second operation from the same gang adds nothing here, so track which gangs you have covered. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops naturally on the way if you clear operations as you find them. These guarded sites are also the best setup for Gunslinger's five kills in one Combat Focus.
trophies.when: Any time; 100% completion needs all 39 operations.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A hidden one-off: have a cocktail at a spot with a view over Ocean Beach. Honest status at launch: this is one of five hidden trophies whose exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the published guides, so the official description is the instruction. Go to the Ocean Beach area, find a bar or cocktail interaction with a sea view, and use it; if it does not pop, try the other oceanfront venues before assuming anything is broken.
trophies.when: Free roam, Ocean Beach. Trigger not yet confirmed at launch.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, which is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you first visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb, then escape the police. If you leave something behind the operation comes back later, so this one is explicitly not missable.
trophies.when: Chapter 2 onward (Kingpin Bowling). Not missable: the operation returns.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A hidden partner trophy: the reported method is to raise both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner called in, because the partner trains alongside you and levels at the same time, which halves the work. roadmap.title: Chapter 1 — start clean, protect the one missable
roadmap.body: Play Gone Fishing, then do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (a morning after Down to Earth) BEFORE finishing Chapter 1: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and never comes back. Start the save habit now: one manual save at the start of every chapter, rotated, because there is no mission replay. Cheap early clears: beat Cal at fishing and finish one arcade game.

roadmap.title: Chapter 2 — the game opens up
roadmap.body: Breakfast Run unlocks switching and calling in your partner, which starts the partner trophies. After Daily Driver, buy garages in the Real Estate app (all 8 cost about $160,000 and feed Little Boxes and Treat Yo Self). The mission Moses opens Scooter Bros registrations. Rob Kingpin Bowling (the Kolt & Associates alley) with Sticky Bombs and take all three valuables.

roadmap.title: Chapter 3 — time-sensitive, act on sight
roadmap.body: Take Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs for the Snap Gun and Sneakthief, chain three shop robberies with your partner for Retail Therapy, and run Race Against Yago the moment it appears: that hourglass strand can expire, and it counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4 — robbery season
roadmap.body: Near the end of the chapter, do the optional mission That's Where The Money Is to unlock bank vaults. Vault runs with your partner cover Maximum Withdrawal progress and can pop Hot Together on the escape; route every Marked Bill to your contacts for Dime on the Dollar.

roadmap.title: The finale — with a safety save
roadmap.body: Before the final mission, park an untouched manual save and never overwrite it. Finish the story for the gold, You Gotta Know When to Get Off. The 100% checklist now appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, with everything you already did counted.

roadmap.title: The 100% grind — the long tail
roadmap.body: Work the checklist in sweeps, not one trophy at a time: 300 stunts (250 pops Cunning Stunts on the way), 70 of 80 Challenges (50 pops One Last Thing), 42 Shooting Range golds, a Top Fun win at all 14 locations, WAiNK at 100 locations, 200 vehicles scanned (100 pops Whip It Good), all 52 areas, 3 card sets, the remaining meditation spots, all 39 gang operations (9 gangs pop Pest Control), all 8 vaults, $100,000 spent and $250,000 laundered.

roadmap.title: Side stories and strangers
roadmap.body: Finish the six named side-story finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret's hunt) and complete 8 stranger strands for the silver Strangers & Freaks, remembering the named finales do not count toward those 8. Side-story finales stay available after the credits, so nothing here can be lost by finishing the story first.

roadmap.title: One-off moments and partner feats
roadmap.body: Mop up the set pieces: a jet from a VCIA boarding bridge (gates E3/E4), a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, 5 kills in one Combat Focus at a gang operation, an armored truck robbery, maximum Strength for both characters at the gym, a cocktail above Ocean Beach, a showroom smash-out, and the still-unconfirmed hidden one-offs, which may already have popped on the way.

roadmap.title: Platinum
roadmap.body: When the other 54 are all ticked, Vice Got a Price! unlocks by itself. If exactly one counter is short, it is almost always a grind total (stunts, Challenges or vehicles) rather than a missed story beat, because the story trophies cannot be missed and only one trophy on the whole list is missable.
